steps.name: inspect-recovered-host-load-and-interrupted-check-log
steps.command:
set -eu
echo 'HOST_UPTIME_AND_LOAD'
uptime
echo 'TEST_TASK_LOG_TAIL'
LOG=/tmp/shelly-ionic-BLE-173-check.log
if test -f "$LOG";then
 echo "LOG_BYTES=$(wc -c < "$LOG" | tr -d ' ')"
 tail -85 "$LOG"
else echo NO_LOG;fi
echo 'LEFTOVER_TEST_PROCESSES'
ps -axo pid,rss,command | grep -E '[v]itest|[p]laywright|[g]radle|[t]sc -p|[r]ollup|[v]ite build' | head -35 || true
echo 'WORKTREE'
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
